notes: Protocol v2: supersedes v1 by correcting the axios-01 script oracle (proposal 0001); every other task, pin, budget and run size is unchanged. randomizationSeed is deliberately identical to the v1 manifest's, so the 78-trial order matches v1 trial-for-trial and the two versions can be compared task by task instead of by different shuffles. Budgets are unchanged from v1: 20,000,000 tokens is about 3x the 78 x ~78,800 input tokens the six measured pilot trials imply, and 2,880 minutes stays far above the ~24 minutes those trials project. Raw records cite this id, so a v2 record can never be mistaken for a v1 one; records of the two versions are refused by the same aggregate.
